text.p: The Coca-Cola Co said on Wednesday that it would sponsor a 20-city bus tour from June 19 to July 31 in conjunction with the Boys & Girls Clubs of America for a promotion called the Incredible Summer.

A specially designed luxury motorcoach was scheduled to stop one day in each city to take members of the local Boys & Girls Club out for a day of amusement park rides, baseball games, go-cart racing, pizza parties and other summer activities.
As part of the promotion, Coke said it would offer more than $50 million in prizes, including $10 million in cash.
Discounts on Coke products also would be available through an "ATM money card" feature co-sponsored by MasterCard.
The kickoff was scheduled for Thursday in Atlanta and was to feature actress Shirley Jones, who played the bus-driving matriarch on "The Partridge Family" television series in the 1970s.
